gate: Lee et al. 2014 SRP040309 SRA metadata-only source map
permitted_operations: query NCBI SRA E-utilities for SRP040309 metadata
record library strategy, source, selection, layout, platform, release dates, spots/bases and public metadata returned by RunInfo
hash the exact RunInfo response used
forbidden_operations: select samples based on observed molecular outcomes
construct chi_bio, Chi_bio, or Bio Chi
pass_rule: SRP040309 resolves to one or more public SRA runs with explicit experiment/sample/project identities in a hash-pinned RunInfo response
fail_rule: study accession does not resolve, RunInfo is unavailable/unparseable, or identity is ambiguous
